name: Speed up a WooCommerce store and keep it fast
why: Orders speed fixes for a WooCommerce shop from its PageSpeed report and sets a budget that keeps it fast after updates.

name: Self-hosted store speed fixer
why: Hosting, caching, plugin and image fixes in a safe order for a WooCommerce site.

name: WooCommerce store setup planner
why: A build plan from hosting to the first test order, useful before custom plugin work starts.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves the cause before any fix and hands over a minimal change, the same habit as the break-fix skill.

name: Weekly dependency and security sweep
why: Tracks what is new, open or fixed each week with an upgrade order, matching the monthly maintenance workflow.

name: Release manager
why: A go or no-go, changelog and rollback plan before each plugin or site release.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Plans a restore test so the backup behind every update plan is proven to work.

name: Threat list maker
why: Ranks the likeliest attacks on a site or plugin before the security hardening pass.

name: Private bug evidence assistant
why: Helps an owner turn rough notes and screenshots into a bug report with private data removed, the input the break-fix skill needs.

name: Turn an incident into a safer procedure
why: Turns a site outage or hack into a blameless report and prevention steps for the owner.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Keeps accessibility gaps ranked each quarter, useful for WooCommerce shops selling to EU consumers.

name: Website quality keeper
why: A weekly check of what got slower or harder to find after updates.
